comment: Excellent teacher. Cares about students. Will help and wants you to do well
Dr. Nebel is student focused. He got me through and spent a lot of  extra time with me. He really loves teaching and lets us know we are his top priority.

I did very well in this class, but if I hadn't taken 2 years of physics in highschool I would have been screwed. You have to show up everyday to do the labs and here's a big clue: DO YOUR HOMEWORK. It's a life saver. Tests are 6 questions and you pick 5 for him to grade, he doesn't curve, but the final is easy. Oh and he favors the ladies.
Very nice guy. Do you homework and go see him for help and you will do fine. Class is just ok.

Very nice guy and really smart. Goes pretty fast, but helps if you ask for it. Tests were alright, and always goes over homework in class which is really helpful. Overall, a good class that wasn't too terribly hard for physics.

Oh Neebs. His class was incredibly boring, but what can you expect from a 3-hour long physics class? Not really any surprises (he pretty much tells what's on the test--he just changes the numbers in book problems). He is weird about grading--takes off disproportionate amounts of points. Not too hard to do well. And he wears oversized shirts.
